Shah Ali Welfare Foundation


“For the welfare of people, for the protection of nature, on the path to Allah’s pleasure”


This is a non-political, non-profit, non-communal, ideology-based, social, non-governmental voluntary organization dedicated to serving distressed humanity. It will work for the welfare of all humanity, the establishment of universal brotherhood, and the establishment of overall peace and harmony. It will also promote the contributions of the saints (Awliya) and work to improve the lives of destitute people.

title: Shah Ali Welfare Foundation
text:
Mission
To build a just, rational, environmentally conscious, and spiritually value-based society where every individual can live with dignity, equal opportunities, and mutual harmony, and where future generations inherit a safe and sustainable planet.

title: Shah Ali Welfare Foundation
text:
Vision
To build a welfare-oriented society through humanitarian service, environmental conservation, and spiritual values.

title: Shah Ali Welfare Foundation
text:
Aims and Objectives

To provide medical treatment, education, self-development opportunities, and knowledge based on moral and exemplary values to orphaned, homeless, destitute, and disadvantaged street children.
To maintain environmental balance through tree plantation and afforestation; to protect forest resources and encourage and support initiatives aimed at forest conservation.
To build a healthy, safe, and self-reliant society by preventing the spread of drug abuse, creating employment opportunities, and ensuring public health and well-being.
To protect and care for stray dogs, stray cats, frogs, birds, insects, and other animals.
To conserve rivers, ponds, and other water bodies and keep them clean.
To establish, operate, and maintain primary, secondary, and higher educational institutions, as well as technical and vocational education and training institutions, with the objective of developing human resources.
To promote women’s welfare and create employment opportunities for unemployed men and women. To provide financial assistance for social welfare activities according to the organization’s capacity.
To undertake modern fish farming projects to create employment opportunities for unemployed men and women and conduct research to increase hygienic and healthy fish production.
To promote the welfare and rehabilitation of released prisoners.
To promote the welfare of juvenile offenders. To organize various meetings, seminars, and symposiums to raise public awareness about measures necessary to prevent child trafficking.
To promote the welfare of beggars and disadvantaged people.
To promote the welfare and rehabilitation of patients.
To undertake initiatives for the welfare of young people and women through education, lifestyle development, and employment opportunities; to ensure social security and provide assistance in addressing various life-related challenges.
To promote the welfare of elderly men and women who are physically incapacitated or otherwise unable to support themselves.
To raise public awareness about climate change and empower disadvantaged and poor farmers by distributing agricultural inputs and materials to support their agricultural activities.
To increase health awareness among marginalized communities and provide various forms of aid by conducting seminars, surveys, and research activities.
To provide free cataract surgery to disadvantaged patients.
To provide scholarships and financial assistance to meritorious students.
To prevent child labour and support the mental and physical development of children for their overall well-being.
To establish publications, bookshops, reading rooms, and libraries to develop and promote reading habits among people and facilitate their access to the Foundation’s educational resources.
To establish and operate religious institutions, madrasas, mosques, khanqahs, Darbars (Sufi shrines), and guest houses for travelers (Musafirkhanas).
To organize religious programmes and celebrations to foster love and devotion towards the Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the Ahl al-Bayt (the family of the Prophet). Such occasions may include Eid-e-Milad-un-Nabi, Shab-e-Barat, and Shab-e-Meraj, among others.
To assist the public and the administration in responding to and managing natural disasters.
To establish and operate charitable medical centers in underprivileged areas to provide medical facilities to disadvantaged communities.
To undertake motivational activities to promote awareness of literature and the arts, as well as scientific thinking and a scientific outlook.
To collect and preserve technical and scientific maps, diagrams, and plans for the benefit and convenience of the public.
To distribute free books among underprivileged students of schools, colleges, universities, and madrasas, as well as among Islamic scholars (Ulama), with the objective of improving the quality of education.
To form and operate management committees for all educational institutions, religious institutions, charitable medical centers, and other establishments operating under the Foundation.
To conduct research on Sufi philosophy and comparative religion in accordance with international standards.
To organize various religious programmes, including Milad Mahfils, Isal-e-Sawab gatherings, and Urs Sharif celebrations, with the objective of promoting the honour, dignity, and glorious heritage of revered Muslim saints and Sufi personalities. To undertake various social welfare and charitable activities on the occasion of such programmes and commemorative days.
To organize various activities to celebrate the annual Urs Mubarak of Sultanul Awliya Shah Ali Baghdadi (R), for three days during the first week of the month of Dhul Hijjah each year. Such activities shall include:

Arranging free primary medical treatment, distributing medicines, and organizing medical camps.
Arranging cataract surgeries and circumcision procedures in collaboration with hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare institutions, as well as raising health awareness among adolescent boys and girls.
Arranging the distribution of Tabarruk (blessed food and offerings).
Distributing Sehri and Iftar food supplies.
Providing gifts to shrine employees, street children, and children with special needs.
Organizing discussion programmes, seminars, and symposiums.

To undertake renovation and repair works of any Sufi shrine or mausoleum (Mazar Sharif), as necessary.
To give special attention to the shrine of Shah Ali Baghdadi (R).
To observe and celebrate important religious occasions and commemorative days.
To distribute winter clothing among destitute, poor, disadvantaged, and homeless people.
To arrange the provision of safe and pure drinking water.
To arrange food for poor, disadvantaged, and homeless people during the month of Ramadan. On the occasions of Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-ul-Adha, to distribute semai, sugar, and other food items, as well as new clothing, among those in need.
